typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		InputLine as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(InputLine = InputLine) ~> PlaceHolderScriptGetLineNumber
PlaceHolderScriptGetLineNumber derive(JobId = $JobId,
		JobFileId = $JobFileId) ~> DerivedColumnAddColumns
DerivedColumnAddColumns sink(input(
		InputLine as string,
		LineNumber as integer,
		JobId as integer,
		JobFileId as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		InputLine,
		LineNumber,
		JobId,
		JobFileId)) ~> OLEDBDestination
